question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**ago**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Ago**" is an adverb that means "before now" or "in the past."
 
• It is often used to indicate a period of time that has passed since a specific event.
 
• In the blank, "**ago**" is indeed the correct choice. It's used to indicate a specific point in the past, referring to a time period that has already passed before the present moment or another point in the past.
 
• "**Ago**" helps convey when the event took place in relation to the present moment or another past event, providing clarity and context to the timeframe.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Prior**" is an adjective that means "existing or occurring before in time or order."
 
• "**Before**" is a preposition that means "in advance of" or "earlier than."
 
• The word "**sooner**" is an adverb that means "before the expected time" or "earlier than planned."
